Patient: Rafael Szabo | DOB: 05/03/1971 | MRN: SYN-6051666
Date of service: 02/19/2025 | Dr. Ylva Fenwick, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
53-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2020, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 27 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 32.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
